dwell_overview.label: Dwell Overview
dwell_overview.description: Fleet dwell-time analytics and SLA monitoring (scoped to the active region and vehicle).

data.query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT SESSION_ID) AS total_trips, ROUND(AVG(DWELL_MINUTES),1) AS avg_dwell, SUM(CASE WHEN DWELL_MINUTES <= 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)*1.0/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS sla_frac, COUNT(DISTINCT VEHICLE_ID) AS active_drivers FROM FLEET_APP.DWELL.VW_DWELL_SESSIONS

SELECT SUBSTR(TO_VARCHAR(TREND_DATE),6) AS day, total_dwells, total_trips FROM ( SELECT TREND_DATE, TOTAL_SESSIONS AS total_dwells, ACTIVE_VEHICLES AS total_trips FROM FLEET_APP.DWELL.VW_DAILY_TRENDS ORDER BY TREND_DATE DESC LIMIT 30 ) ORDER BY day ASC
SELECT SUBSTR(LOCATION_NAME,1,20) AS facility_name, SUM(TOTAL_SESSIONS) AS total_visits FROM FLEET_APP.DWELL.VW_FACILITY_UTILIZATION GROUP BY LOCATION_NAME ORDER BY total_visits DESC LIMIT 10

dwell_congestion.label: Congestion Map
dwell_congestion.description: H3 dwell-density hexagons by hour of day (drag the slider to change the hour).

data.query: SELECT H3_CELL_R7 AS h3_index, SUM(SESSION_COUNT) AS dwell_count, ROUND(AVG(AVG_DWELL_MIN),1) AS avg_dwell_min FROM FLEET_APP.DWELL.VW_H3_CONGESTION WHERE EXTRACT(HOUR FROM HOUR_BUCKET) = TO_NUMBER(:selected_hour) GROUP BY H3_CELL_R7 LIMIT 5000

dwell_facilities.label: Facility Utilization
dwell_facilities.description: Dwell load by facility and facility type — where vehicles spend the most time.

data.query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT LOCATION_ID) AS facilities, SUM(TOTAL_SESSIONS) AS total_visits, ROUND(AVG(AVG_DWELL_MIN),1) AS avg_dwell, ROUND(MAX(MAX_DWELL_MIN),0) AS max_dwell FROM FLEET_APP.DWELL.VW_FACILITY_UTILIZATION
SELECT SUBSTR(LOCATION_NAME,1,22) AS facility_name, SUM(TOTAL_DWELL_MIN) AS dwell_min FROM FLEET_APP.DWELL.VW_FACILITY_UTILIZATION GROUP BY LOCATION_NAME ORDER BY dwell_min DESC LIMIT 12
SELECT COALESCE(FACILITY_TYPE,'unknown') AS facility_type, SUM(TOTAL_SESSIONS) AS visits FROM FLEET_APP.DWELL.VW_FACILITY_UTILIZATION GROUP BY FACILITY_TYPE ORDER BY visits DESC

dwell_drivers.label: Driver Performance
dwell_drivers.description: Per-driver dwell totals and SLA breaches — click a column header to sort.

data.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS drivers, SUM(SLA_BREACH_COUNT) AS sla_breaches, SUM(CRITICAL_BREACH_COUNT) AS critical_breaches, ROUND(AVG(AVG_SESSION_MIN),1) AS avg_session FROM FLEET_APP.DWELL.VW_DRIVER_DWELL_SUMMARY
SELECT VEHICLE_ID AS driver, SLA_BREACH_COUNT AS breaches FROM FLEET_APP.DWELL.VW_DRIVER_DWELL_SUMMARY ORDER BY breaches DESC LIMIT 12

SELECT VEHICLE_ID AS driver, DRIVER_PROFILE AS profile, HOME_BASE_NAME AS home_base, TOTAL_DWELL_HOURS AS dwell_hours, SLA_BREACH_COUNT AS sla_breaches, CRITICAL_BREACH_COUNT AS critical FROM FLEET_APP.DWELL.VW_DRIVER_DWELL_SUMMARY ORDER BY sla_breaches DESC LIMIT 100

dwell_sla.label: SLA Alerts
dwell_sla.description: Dwell sessions that breached SLA thresholds, by severity.

data.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS alerts, SUM(IFF(SLA_STATUS='CRITICAL',1,0)) AS critical, SUM(IFF(SLA_STATUS='WARNING',1,0)) AS warning, ROUND(AVG(MINUTES_OVER_WARNING),1) AS avg_over FROM FLEET_APP.DWELL.VW_SLA_ALERTS
SELECT SLA_STATUS AS status, COUNT(*) AS alerts FROM FLEET_APP.DWELL.VW_SLA_ALERTS GROUP BY SLA_STATUS ORDER BY alerts DESC

SELECT VEHICLE_ID AS driver, SUBSTR(LOCATION_NAME,1,24) AS location, SLA_STATUS AS status, ROUND(DWELL_MINUTES,0) AS dwell_min, ROUND(MINUTES_OVER_WARNING,0) AS over_warning FROM FLEET_APP.DWELL.VW_SLA_ALERTS ORDER BY MINUTES_OVER_WARNING DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 100

deviation_overview.label: Route Deviation
deviation_overview.description: Planned vs actual route adherence — daily trend and worst drivers.

data.query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT TRIP_ID) AS total_trips, SUM(IFF(IS_ROUTE_DEVIATION,1,0)) AS deviation_trips, SUM(IFF(IS_ROUTE_DEVIATION,1,0))*1.0/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS deviation_frac, ROUND(SUM(DISTANCE_DEVIATION_KM),0) AS excess_km FROM FLEET_APP.ROUTE_DEVIATION.VW_TRIP_DEVIATION
SELECT TO_VARCHAR(TRIP_DATE) AS day, DEVIATION_RATE_PCT AS deviation_rate, TOTAL_TRIPS AS trips FROM FLEET_APP.ROUTE_DEVIATION.VW_DAILY_DEVIATION_TRENDS ORDER BY TRIP_DATE
SELECT DRIVER_ID AS driver, DEVIATION_RATE_PCT AS deviation_rate FROM FLEET_APP.ROUTE_DEVIATION.VW_DRIVER_DEVIATION_SUMMARY ORDER BY deviation_rate DESC LIMIT 12

deviation_routes.label: Route Comparison
deviation_routes.description: Actual (red) vs expected (blue) driven paths for the most-deviating trips.

data.query: SELECT TRIP_ID AS trip_id, ST_ASGEOJSON(EXPECTED_PATH)::STRING AS expected_geojson FROM FLEET_APP.ROUTE_DEVIATION.VW_TRIP_DEVIATION WHERE EXPECTED_PATH IS NOT NULL AND IS_ROUTE_DEVIATION ORDER BY DISTANCE_DEVIATION_PCT DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT TRIP_ID AS trip_id, ST_ASGEOJSON(ACTUAL_PATH)::STRING AS actual_geojson FROM FLEET_APP.ROUTE_DEVIATION.VW_TRIP_DEVIATION WHERE ACTUAL_PATH IS NOT NULL AND IS_ROUTE_DEVIATION ORDER BY DISTANCE_DEVIATION_PCT DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT TRIP_ID AS trip_id, DRIVER_ID AS driver, SUBSTR(ORIGIN_NAME,1,18) AS origin, SUBSTR(DEST_NAME,1,18) AS destination, ROUND(DISTANCE_DEVIATION_PCT,1) AS dev_pct, ROUND(DISTANCE_DEVIATION_KM,1) AS excess_km FROM FLEET_APP.ROUTE_DEVIATION.VW_TRIP_DEVIATION WHERE IS_ROUTE_DEVIATION ORDER BY DISTANCE_DEVIATION_PCT DESC LIMIT 20

taxi_overview.label: Taxi Overview
taxi_overview.description: Taxi fleet trip volume, speed, and shift mix.

data.query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT TRIP_ID) AS total_trips, COUNT(DISTINCT DRIVER_ID) AS drivers, ROUND(AVG(ROUTE_DISTANCE_METERS)/1000,1) AS avg_dist_km, ROUND(AVG(AVERAGE_KMH),1) AS avg_speed FROM FLEET_APP.TAXI.VW_TRIP_SUMMARY
SELECT COALESCE(SHIFT_TYPE,'unknown') AS shift, COUNT(*) AS trips FROM FLEET_APP.TAXI.VW_TRIP_SUMMARY GROUP BY SHIFT_TYPE ORDER BY trips DESC
SELECT COALESCE(REGION,'unknown') AS region, ROUND(AVG(AVERAGE_KMH),1) AS avg_speed FROM FLEET_APP.TAXI.VW_TRIP_SUMMARY GROUP BY REGION ORDER BY avg_speed DESC LIMIT 12

taxi_routes.label: Taxi Routes
taxi_routes.description: Driven taxi trip paths (longest trips shown) on the map.

data.query: SELECT TRIP_ID AS trip_id, ST_ASGEOJSON(GEOMETRY)::STRING AS route_geojson FROM FLEET_APP.TAXI.VW_TRIP_SUMMARY WHERE GEOMETRY IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ROUTE_DISTANCE_METERS DESC LIMIT 60

SELECT TRIP_ID AS trip_id, DRIVER_ID AS driver, SUBSTR(ORIGIN_ADDRESS,1,22) AS origin, SUBSTR(DESTINATION_ADDRESS,1,22) AS destination, ROUND(ROUTE_DISTANCE_METERS/1000,1) AS dist_km, ROUND(ROUTE_DURATION_SECS/60,1) AS dur_min FROM FLEET_APP.TAXI.VW_TRIP_SUMMARY WHERE GEOMETRY IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ROUTE_DISTANCE_METERS DESC LIMIT 60

food_delivery.label: Food Delivery
food_delivery.description: Courier delivery performance and busiest restaurants.

data.query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT DELIVERY_ID) AS deliveries, COUNT(DISTINCT COURIER_ID) AS couriers, ROUND(AVG(DELIVERY_TIME_MIN),1) AS avg_time, ROUND(AVG(DISTANCE_KM),1) AS avg_dist FROM FLEET_APP.FOOD_DELIVERY.VW_DELIVERIES
SELECT SUBSTR(RESTAURANT_NAME,1,22) AS restaurant, TOTAL_ORDERS AS orders FROM FLEET_APP.FOOD_DELIVERY.VW_RESTAURANTS_ENRICHED ORDER BY orders DESC LIMIT 12

SELECT ROUND(DISTANCE_KM,1) AS distance_km, ROUND(DELIVERY_TIME_MIN,1) AS delivery_time_min FROM FLEET_APP.FOOD_DELIVERY.VW_DELIVERIES WHERE DELIVERY_TIME_MIN IS NOT NULL AND DISTANCE_KM IS NOT NULL LIMIT 400

retail_catchment.label: Retail Catchment
retail_catchment.description: Retail points of interest by category and location.

data.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS pois, COUNT(DISTINCT BASIC_CATEGORY) AS categories, COUNT(DISTINCT CITY) AS cities, COUNT(DISTINCT STATE) AS states FROM FLEET_APP.RETAIL_CATCHMENT.VW_RETAIL_POIS
SELECT BASIC_CATEGORY AS category, COUNT(*) AS pois FROM FLEET_APP.RETAIL_CATCHMENT.VW_RETAIL_POIS GROUP BY BASIC_CATEGORY ORDER BY pois DESC LIMIT 12

SELECT POI_NAME AS poi_name, BASIC_CATEGORY AS category, LONGITUDE AS lng, LATITUDE AS lat FROM FLEET_APP.RETAIL_CATCHMENT.VW_RETAIL_POIS WHERE LATITUDE IS NOT NULL AND LONGITUDE IS NOT NULL LIMIT 5000

asset_velocity.label: Asset Velocity
asset_velocity.description: Idle trailers, cost of idleness, and where they are parked.

data.query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT VEHICLE_ID) AS idle_trailers, ROUND(SUM(COST_OF_IDLENESS_USD),0) AS cost_usd, ROUND(SUM(PROJECTED_SAVINGS_USD),0) AS savings_usd, ROUND(AVG(IDLE_DAYS),1) AS avg_idle_days FROM FLEET_APP.ROUTE_OPTIMIZATION.VW_TRAILER_COST_OF_IDLENESS
SELECT IDLE_SEVERITY AS severity, COUNT(*) AS trailers FROM FLEET_APP.ROUTE_OPTIMIZATION.VW_TRAILER_COST_OF_IDLENESS GROUP BY IDLE_SEVERITY ORDER BY trailers DESC

SELECT VEHICLE_ID AS vehicle_id, IDLE_SEVERITY AS severity, IDLE_DAYS AS idle_days, LAST_LNG AS lng, LAST_LAT AS lat FROM FLEET_APP.ROUTE_OPTIMIZATION.VW_TRAILER_COST_OF_IDLENESS WHERE LAST_LAT IS NOT NULL AND LAST_LNG IS NOT NULL LIMIT 2000

fleet_operations.label: Fleet Operations
fleet_operations.description: Unified fleet telemetry and trips: volume, detours, and safety events.

data.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS trips, ROUND(SUM(DISTANCE_KM),0) AS total_km, SUM(IFF(IS_DETOUR,1,0)) AS detours, ROUND(AVG(DURATION_MINUTES),1) AS avg_duration FROM SYNTHETIC_DATASETS.UNIFIED.V_FACT_TRIPS_CURRENT

SELECT COUNT(*) AS pings, SUM(IFF(IS_SPEEDING,1,0)) AS speeding, SUM(IFF(IS_HOS_VIOLATION,1,0)) AS hos, ROUND(AVG(SPEED_KMH),1) AS avg_speed FROM SYNTHETIC_DATASETS.UNIFIED.V_FACT_VEHICLE_TELEMETRY_CURRENT
SELECT REGION AS region, COUNT(*) AS trips FROM SYNTHETIC_DATASETS.UNIFIED.V_FACT_TRIPS_CURRENT GROUP BY REGION ORDER BY trips DESC
SELECT VEHICLE_TYPE AS vehicle_type, COUNT(*) AS trips FROM SYNTHETIC_DATASETS.UNIFIED.V_FACT_TRIPS_CURRENT GROUP BY VEHICLE_TYPE ORDER BY trips DESC

fleet_map.label: Fleet Map
fleet_map.description: Live vehicle telemetry points — click a vehicle to highlight its pings.

data.query: SELECT VEHICLE_ID AS vehicle_id, COUNT(*) AS pings, SUM(IFF(IS_SPEEDING,1,0)) AS speeding FROM SYNTHETIC_DATASETS.UNIFIED.V_FACT_VEHICLE_TELEMETRY_CURRENT GROUP BY VEHICLE_ID ORDER BY pings DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT VEHICLE_ID AS vehicle_id, LONGITUDE AS lng, LATITUDE AS lat, ROUND(SPEED_KMH,0) AS speed_kmh FROM SYNTHETIC_DATASETS.UNIFIED.V_FACT_VEHICLE_TELEMETRY_CURRENT WHERE LATITUDE IS NOT NULL SAMPLE (5000 ROWS)
